method: Direct invocation of the pinned production GRPOTrainer._compute_loss on a differentiable two-sequence CPU fixture. The checker computes sequence-level expectations from the equations above without importing TRL or PyTorch. No model, dataset, optimizer, GPU, or external service.
failure_criteria: candidate identity differs from pinned PR revision or exact one-file patch hash
unmodified fp16 baseline does not exhibit the declared non-finite KL metric
candidate fp16 result is non-finite or outside the analytic tolerance
candidate produces nonzero gradient on masked padding
float32 candidate differs from the PR head
